title: Attention Is All You Need for Chinese Word Segmentation
answer_short: Gaussian-masked directional multi-head attention is a variant of scaled dot-product attention that incorporates a Gaussian weight matrix to emphasize local relationships and directional masks to focus on forward and backward contexts.
answer_rationale: The Gaussian-masked directional multi-head attention is described as a variant of scaled dot-product attention that uses a Gaussian weight matrix to assign higher weights to closer characters and directional masks to enforce forward and backward attention patterns. This mechanism is specifically designed to capture localness and directional information for Chinese word segmentation tasks.
